objective: Bring the user docs in line with holyagent 0.1.2-2, document the plugin dependencies and how to satisfy them on every surface, and describe claude.ai as one unified Claude rather than chat versus Cowork.
scope: docs/usage.md:62 still says giving JSON on both stdin and --input is refused; since 0.1.2-2 --input wins and stdin is not read when --input is given (packages/runtime/src/cli/context.ts payloadOf).

docs/hooks.md:7 and :23 say the migrate notice appears whenever .holyclaude/ or .holycodex/ exists; it now appears only when the folder holds convertible state (packages/runtime/src/state/legacy.ts legacyFoldersWithState: holyclaude needs files under intents/<folder>/, holycodex a non-dot <folder>/... path).

docs/components.md:60 lists two Exa tool prefixes; there are three: mcp__claude_ai_Exa__ (desktop app connector), mcp__Exa__ (claude.ai cloud session connector), mcp__plugin_exa_exa__ (Exa plugin) (packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts WEB). Add one sentence there that the names are listed exactly because a tools wildcard such as mcp__Exa__* is documented (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) but reported not to work (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/53865) and would also grant agent_run, which the librarians leave out.

Document the dependencies where the docs explain installing holyagent (find that place; docs/README.md, docs/usage.md and the 0.1.2 desktop-plugin-install docs are candidates; add to an existing section, no new file). Facts, with these sources: holyagent declares billion-context@billion-context (marketplace github ranxianglei/billion-context) and exa@claude-plugins-official as required dependencies and does not load without them. A plugin cannot declare where a dependency's marketplace comes from; installing from a marketplace auto-installs a dependency only when the user already has its marketplace and the root marketplace allows it in allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/dependencies). When holyagent is turned on in a claude.ai account it loads in Claude Code as holyagent@synced, and its dependencies count as met when the user turns on billion-context and exa on claude.ai too (after adding github ranxianglei/billion-context as a marketplace under Customize > Plugins) or installs them from their marketplaces (same page, section 'Dependencies when your plugin loads from claude.ai'; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading).

Unified Claude: chat and Cowork are one Claude on claude.ai web, desktop and mobile (https://claude.com/resources/articles/cowork-is-now-claude, 2026-09-16; https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16761823-claude-cowork-and-chat-are-one-claude). A conversation starts as a chat and continues in a Cowork cloud session when a task needs to run code or work with files; plugins carry over. Plugin agents and hooks load in Cowork sessions and Claude Code, and are skipped where a conversation stays plain chat (https://claude.com/docs/plugins/platform-support). Replace any text that presents chat and Cowork as separate places to choose between; keep Claude Code (terminal, IDE, desktop Code tab, claude.ai/code cloud sessions) as its own surface. Do not claim holyagent is tested in a unified-Claude Cowork session: it is not yet.
